detail.command: ls -la ~/.pi/agent/ 2>/dev/null; echo "---"; cat ~/.pi/agent/config.json 2>/dev/null || cat ~/.pi/agent/config.* 2>/dev/null
cat ~/.pi/agent/npm/package.json 2>/dev/null; echo "=== adapter pkg ==="; cat ~/.pi/agent/npm/node_modules/pi-mcp-adapter/package.json
cat ~/.pi/agent/settings.json; echo "=== extensions dir ==="; ls -la ~/.pi/agent/extensions/
cd ~/.pi/agent/npm && npm view pi-mcp-adapter versions --json 2>/dev/null | tail -20
cd /tmp && npm view pi-mcp-adapter@5.3.1 dependencies peerDependencies pi --json 2>/dev/null

grep -rn "mcp" ~/.pi/agent/install/releases/1.3.0/node_modules/@earendil-works/pi-coding-agent/package.json | head -20; echo "=== builtin mcp ext ==="; ls ~/.pi/agent/install/releases/1.3.0/node_modules/@earendil-works/pi-coding-agent/dist/extensions/ 2>/dev/null | head -40
grep -rn "builtin\|builtIn\|Built-in" ~/.pi/agent/install/releases/1.3.0/node_modules/@earendil-works/pi-coding-agent/README.md | head -30
ls ~/.pi/agent/install/releases/1.3.0/node_modules/@earendil-works/pi-coding-agent/docs/

grep -rn "builtin\|builtIn\|built-in" ~/.pi/agent/install/releases/1.3.0/node_modules/@earendil-works/pi-coding-agent/docs/extensions.md ~/.pi/agent/install/releases/1.3.0/node_modules/@earendil-works/pi-coding-agent/docs/settings.md ~/.pi/agent/install/releases/1.3.0/node_modules/@earendil-works/pi-coding-agent/docs/mcp.md | head -40

sed -n '250,290p' ~/.pi/agent/install/releases/1.3.0/node_modules/@earendil-works/pi-coding-agent/docs/mcp.md; echo "=== packages.md peer ==="; grep -n "peerDependencies" -A6 -B6 ~/.pi/agent/install/releases/1.3.0/node_modules/@earendil-works/pi-coding-agent/docs/packages.md
cat ~/.pi/agent/mcp.json; echo "=== rea backup ==="; cat ~/.pi/agent/mcp.json.rea.backup

cd /tmp && npm view pi-mcp-adapter@5.3.1 --json 2>/dev/null | python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get('version')); print(json.dumps(d.get('pi'),indent=1))"; echo "=== changelog ==="; curl -s https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nicobailon/pi-mcp-adapter/main/CHANGELOG.md 2>/dev/null | head -80
cd ~/.pi/agent/install/releases/1.3.0/node_modules/@earendil-works/pi-coding-agent && grep -rn "peerDependencies" dist/*.js | head -20

cd ~/.pi/agent/install/releases/1.3.0/node_modules/@earendil-works/pi-coding-agent && ls; echo "---"; ls dist | head; echo "--- grep"; grep -rln "Host-provided extension packages must be declared" . 2>/dev/null | head
cd ~/.pi/agent/install/releases/1.3.0/node_modules/@earendil-works/pi-coding-agent && grep -n "Host-provided extension packages" -B40 dist/core/resource-loader.js | head -80
which pi; pi --version 2>&1 | head -3; echo "---"; pi package --help 2>&1 | head -40
pi install --help 2>&1 | head -40; echo "=== update ==="; pi update --help 2>&1 | head -30

cd /tmp && rm -rf pmca && mkdir pmca && cd pmca && npm pack pi-mcp-adapter@5.3.1 2>/dev/null | tail -1 && tar xzf pi-mcp-adapter-5.3.1.tgz && grep -rn "builtin:mcp" package/*.ts package/*.js 2>/dev/null | head -20
cd /tmp && mkdir -p pmca531 && cd pmca531 && npm pack pi-mcp-adapter@5.3.1 2>/dev/null | tail -1 && tar xzf pi-mcp-adapter-5.3.1.tgz && grep -rn "builtin:mcp" package/ 2>/dev/null | head -20
cd ~/.pi/agent/install/releases/1.3.0/node_modules/@earendil-works/pi-coding-agent && grep -n "already installed\|existing\|replace\|dedup" dist/core/package-manager.js | head -30
ls -la ~/.pi/agent/npm/; cat ~/.pi/agent/npm/package-lock.json 2>/dev/null | head -20

cp ~/.pi/agent/settings.json /tmp/pi-settings.backup.json && echo "backed up to /tmp/pi-settings.backup.json"; echo "--- installed pi-ai/tui host versions ---"; cat ~/.pi/agent/install/releases/1.3.0/node_modules/@earendil-works/pi-ai/package.json 2>/dev/null | grep '"version"' | head -1; cat ~/.pi/agent/install/releases/1.3.0/node_modules/@earendil-works/pi-tui/package.json 2>/dev/null | grep '"version"' | head -1
cd ~ && pi install npm:pi-mcp-adapter@5.3.1 2>&1 | tail -30
cat ~/.pi/agent/settings.json

cat ~/.pi/agent/npm/node_modules/pi-mcp-adapter/package.json | python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print('version', d['version']); print('deps', d.get('dependencies')); print('peers', d.get('peerDependencies'))"

python3 - <<'EOF'
import json, io
p = "/Users/ekassinghchhabra/.pi/agent/settings.json"
with open(p) as f:
    data = json.load(f, object_pairs_hook=dict)
ext = data["extensions"]
if "-builtin:mcp" not in ext:
    ext.insert(0, "-builtin:mcp")
with open(p, "w") as f:
    json.dump(data, f, indent=2)
    f.write("\n")
print(json.dumps(data["extensions"], indent=2))
EOF
cd ~ && timeout 120 pi list 2>&1 | tail -40
cd ~/.pi/agent/install/releases/1.3.0/node_modules/@earendil-works/pi-coding-agent && grep -rn "collectExtensionPackageWarnings\|extensionWarnings" dist/ --include=*.js | grep -v ".map" | head -20

cd ~/.pi/agent/install/releases/1.3.0/node_modules/@earendil-works/pi-coding-agent && grep -rn "was not loaded\|registers command" dist/core/resource-loader.js | head; echo "=== 400-430 ==="; sed -n '395,430p' dist/core/resource-loader.js
cd ~ && timeout 90 pi --no-session --model definitely-not-a-model -p "hi" 2>&1 | head -60
cd ~ && timeout 60 pi --list-models 2>&1 | grep -i "ollama\|llama\|local" | head -10; echo "=== providers ==="; timeout 60 pi auth status 2>&1 | head -30

cd ~/.pi/agent/install/releases/1.3.0/node_modules/@earendil-works/pi-coding-agent && sed -n '1,60p' dist/core/resource-loader.js | head -60; echo "=== exports ==="; grep -n "^export" dist/core/resource-loader.js | head -20; echo "=== class ==="; grep -n "class ResourceLoader\|static \|createResourceLoader" dist/core/resource-loader.js | head -30
cd ~/.pi/agent/install/releases/1.3.0/node_modules/@earendil-works/pi-coding-agent && sed -n '197,260p' dist/core/resource-loader.js
cd ~ && timeout 60 pi auth check 2>&1 | head -30

cd ~/.pi/agent/install/releases/1.3.0/node_modules/@earendil-works/pi-coding-agent && grep -rn "builtinExtensions\|builtin:mcp" dist/extensions/ dist/core/ dist/modes/ dist/cli.js 2>/dev/null | grep -v "\.map" | head -20

cd ~/.pi/agent/install/releases/1.3.0/node_modules/@earendil-works/pi-coding-agent && grep -rn "isBuiltinExtension\|name: \"mcp\"\|name: 'mcp'" dist/ 2>/dev/null | grep -v "\.map" | head -20; echo "=== extension factories usage ==="; grep -rn "extensionFactories" dist/modes/ dist/cli.js dist/*.js 2>/dev/null | grep -v "\.map" | head -20
cd ~ && timeout 60 pi config < /dev/null 2>&1 | head -60; echo "EXIT:$?"

cd ~/.pi/agent/install/releases/1.3.0/node_modules/@earendil-works/pi-coding-agent && sed -n '1,30p' dist/extensions/index.js; echo "=== main.js builtInExtensions ==="; grep -n "builtInExtensions" dist/main.js | head; sed -n '/const builtInExtensions/,/];/p' dist/main.js | head -20

cd ~/.pi/agent/install/releases/1.3.0/node_modules/@earendil-works/pi-coding-agent && sed -n '630,665p' dist/main.js; echo "=== load methods ==="; grep -n "    async load\|    load(" dist/core/resource-loader.js | head

cd ~/.pi/agent/install/releases/1.3.0/node_modules/@earendil-works/pi-coding-agent && grep -n "getExtensions()" dist/core/resource-loader.js | head; echo "---"; sed -n '/getExtensions()/,/^    }/p' dist/core/resource-loader.js | head -20; echo "=== loadCurrent callers ==="; grep -rn "loadCurrentExtensionSet\|\.load(" dist/main.js dist/modes/**/*.js 2>/dev/null | grep -v "\.map" | head

cd ~/.pi/agent/install/releases/1.3.0/node_modules/@earendil-works/pi-coding-agent && sed -n '496,530p' dist/core/resource-loader.js; echo "=== who calls loadCurrentExtensionSet ==="; grep -rn "loadCurrentExtensionSet" dist/ 2>/dev/null | grep -v "\.map"

cd ~/.pi/agent/install/releases/1.3.0/node_modules/@earendil-works/pi-coding-agent && grep -n "warnings" dist/package-manager-cli.js | head -20; echo "=== loadProjectTrustExtensions ==="; sed -n '349,380p' dist/core/resource-loader.js

find /tmp/pmca531 -delete 2>/dev/null; find /tmp/pmca -delete 2>/dev/null; rm -f /tmp/pi-warncheck.mjs; ls -d /tmp/pmca /tmp/pmca531 /tmp/pi-warncheck.mjs 2>&1; echo "--- stray node procs from checks ---"; pgrep -fl "pi-warncheck|pmca" || echo none

cd /tmp && rm -f pi-warncheck.mjs pmca531/pi-mcp-adapter-5.3.1.tgz pmca531/package.json && find pmca531 -type f -exec rm -f {} + && find pmca531 -depth -type d -exec rmdir {} + 2>/dev/null; find pmca -depth -type d -exec rmdir {} + 2>/dev/null; ls -d /tmp/pmca /tmp/pmca531 /tmp/pi-warncheck.mjs 2>&1; echo "--- procs ---"; pgrep -fl "pi-warncheck|pmca" || echo none
ls ~/.pi/agent/npm/node_modules/pi-mcp-adapter/; echo "=== docs ==="; ls ~/.pi/agent/npm/node_modules/pi-mcp-adapter/docs/ 2>/dev/null
grep -rn "mcp-adapter.json" ~/.pi/agent/npm/node_modules/pi-mcp-adapter/*.ts | head -20
grep -n "directTools\|imports" ~/.pi/agent/npm/node_modules/pi-mcp-adapter/docs/configuration.md | head -40
cd ~/.pi/agent/npm/node_modules/pi-mcp-adapter && grep -n "merge\|override" config.ts | head -40

grep -n "directTools\|imports\|Ignored settings\|ignored" ~/.pi/agent/npm/node_modules/pi-mcp-adapter/docs/tools.md | head -30; echo "=== servers.md ==="; grep -n "override\|merge\|directTools\|imports" ~/.pi/agent/npm/node_modules/pi-mcp-adapter/docs/servers.md | head -30
grep -n "exposure" ~/.pi/agent/install/releases/1.3.0/node_modules/@earendil-works/pi-coding-agent/docs/mcp.md | head -20

for f in ~/.cursor/mcp.json ~/Library/Application\ Support/Claude/claude_desktop_config.json ~/.claude.json ~/.claude/settings.json ~/.config/claude-code/mcp.json ~/.codeium/windsurf/mcp_config.json; do [ -e "$f" ] && echo "EXISTS: $f"; done; echo "--- adapter config dir ---"; ls -la ~/.pi/agent/mcp-adapter.json 2>&1

echo "=== ~/.cursor/mcp.json ==="; cat ~/.cursor/mcp.json; echo; echo "=== ~/.claude.json mcpServers keys ==="; python3 -c "
import json
d=json.load(open('/Users/ekassinghchhabra/.claude.json'))
print('top-level keys:', list(d.keys())[:20])
print('mcpServers:', list((d.get('mcpServers') or {}).keys()))
print('projects with mcpServers:', [k for k,v in (d.get('projects') or {}).items() if isinstance(v,dict) and v.get('mcpServers')])
"
cd ~/.pi/agent/npm/node_modules/pi-mcp-adapter && sed -n '1195,1260p' config.ts; echo "=== ignored keys detection ==="; grep -n "IGNORED\|ignoredKeys\|does not read imports" config.ts | head -20
node --version; ls ~/.pi/agent/npm/node_modules/pi-mcp-adapter/dist 2>/dev/null | head; echo "=== bin ==="; ls ~/.pi/agent/npm/node_modules/.bin/ | grep -i mcp
cp ~/.pi/agent/mcp.json /tmp/mcp.json.backup && echo "backed up"

python3 - <<'EOF'
import json, collections

p = "/Users/ekassinghchhabra/.pi/agent/mcp.json"
with open(p) as f:
    raw = json.load(f, object_pairs_hook=collections.OrderedDict)

imports = raw.pop("imports", None)
cf = raw["mcpServers"].get("cloudflare", {})
cf.pop("directTools", None)
cf["exposure"] = "direct"

out = collections.OrderedDict()
out["mcpServers"] = raw["mcpServers"]
with open(p, "w") as f:
    json.dump(out, f, indent=2); f.write("\n")

adapter = {"imports": imports}
with open("/Users/ekassinghchhabra/.pi/agent/mcp-adapter.json", "w") as f:
    json.dump(adapter, f, indent=2); f.write("\n")

print("mcp.json:"); print(open(p).read())
print("mcp-adapter.json:"); print(open("/Users/ekassinghchhabra/.pi/agent/mcp-adapter.json").read())
EOF
cd ~/.pi/agent/npm/node_modules/pi-mcp-adapter && grep -rn "does not read imports in this file\|Ignored settings (details in" *.ts | head

cd ~/.pi/agent/npm/node_modules/pi-mcp-adapter && grep -n "getLegacyMcpMigrationNotices\|getPiMcpConfigNotices" dist/config.js | head; echo "=== exported in d.ts ==="; grep -n "getLegacyMcpMigrationNotices" dist/config.d.ts
cd ~/.pi/agent/npm/node_modules/pi-mcp-adapter && sed -n '275,300p' config.ts

cd ~/.pi/agent/npm/node_modules/pi-mcp-adapter && grep -n "piMcpConfigEnabled" config.ts | head; echo "=== ts def ==="; sed -n "$(grep -n 'piMcpConfigEnabled *=' config.ts | head -1 | cut -d: -f1),+8p" config.ts; echo "=== dist ==="; grep -n "piMcpConfigEnabled\|no longer reads" dist/config.js | head

cd ~/.pi/agent/npm/node_modules/pi-mcp-adapter && grep -c "Ignored settings (details in /mcp-adapter)" dist/config.js config.ts; echo "--- dist build marker ---"; grep -n '"version"' dist/../package.json | head -1; ls -la dist/config.js config.ts | awk '{print $6,$7,$8,$9}'

rm -f /tmp/pmca-check.mjs /tmp/pmca-check.ts /tmp/pmca-load.mjs; ls /tmp/pmca* 2>&1 | head; echo "--- procs ---"; pgrep -fl "pmca-check|pmca-load" || echo none; echo "--- final configs ---"; ls -la ~/.pi/agent/mcp.json ~/.pi/agent/mcp-adapter.json
